component.name: Clearveil
Clearveil·云开见月明
component.summary: A fast, friendly image viewer for Linux
快速、易用的 Linux 图片查看器

description.p: Clearveil is a canvas-first image viewer designed for fast folder browsing and lightweight image operations.
It supports on-demand local OCR so recognized text can be selected directly on the image and copied without uploading the image.

screenshot.caption: View multiple images in one focused window
在一个简洁窗口中查看多张图片
Browse the current folder without leaving Clearveil
无需离开 Clearveil 即可浏览当前文件夹

description.p: Beta release with responsive asynchronous browsing, configurable layouts, improved crop and color-picker workflows, color-managed display, touch gestures and expanded regression tests.
Initial preview with fast folder browsing, metadata inspection, lightweight editing, configurable layouts and Chinese localization.
